name: out-of-repo
why: Files written outside the repo are invisible to every git command; the skill has to recall them from the session rather than detect them.
setup:
printf '# Migration notes

Draft ordering for the schema migration.
' > /tmp/eval-migration-notes.md
seed: I drafted the schema migration notes this session and wrote them to /tmp/eval-migration-notes.md. They belong in docs/specs/, we are agreed on that and there is nothing further to decide — I simply have not moved them there yet. The repo itself is untouched: nothing edited, nothing committed.

items.about: the migration notes draft written to /tmp, outside the repo

forbid: any git-tracked change — the repo is clean and fully pushed
